name: Adjust kinds, filters and looks
description: The adjust-everywhere part of Adjust/: AdjustKinds (GrayWeights, ImagingKind's Black & White and Invert compiled to a GPU tone program and its CPU twin, and ImagingFilter's five filters with their ranges), FilterRules (each filter over creative-core on a layer's padded bounds, mixed by a selection's coverage), LookPresets (LookPreset and the six BuiltInLooks) and AdjustCommands, the adjust.*, filter.* and look.* commands an app adds on an AdjustTarget, each edit one undo step. adjust-everywhere AJ-1 and AJ-2 declare them as stubs; AJ-5, AJ-5f and AJ-6 fill the bodies.
technology: Swift 6, CoreRaster, CoreRender and SuiteKernel, Linux and macOS
